canonical_title: Roll rate response to small roll commands

versions.title_at_revision: Roll rate response to small roll commands
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle's roll rate response to small roll inputs is no worse than Level 2 as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Roll Rate Response to Small Roll Commands paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle's roll rate response as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Roll Rate Response to Small Roll Commands paragraph and Linearity of Roll Response to Roll Controller paragraph, for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle's roll rate response as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Roll Rate Response to Small Roll Commands paragraph and Linearity of Roll Response to Roll Controller paragraph, for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle's roll rate response as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Roll Rate Response to Small Roll Commands paragraph and Linearity of Roll Response to Roll Controller paragraph, for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
